# 安全通報

只支援最新版本。請透過 GitHub [Security Advisory](https://github.com/Colin955023/MinecraftServerManager/security/advisories) 私下回報；修補發布前不要在 Issue、Discussion 或 PR 公開漏洞或 POC。

請提供：

- 受影響版本與功能
- 最小重現步驟
- 影響與錯誤資訊
- 可行的修補或緩解方式（選填）

範圍包括任意檔案存取、路徑穿越、命令注入、敏感資料洩漏、遠端程式碼執行與權限繞過。

目標時程：7 天內確認、14 天內初步評估、有效漏洞通常在 60 天內修補。若已遭利用或需要更多時間，會在 Advisory 提供狀態與暫行措施。

---

# Vulnerability Reporting

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of Minecraft Server Manager is actively supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report potential security vulnerabilities privately via GitHub [Security Advisories](https://github.com/Colin955023/MinecraftServerManager/security/advisories/new). Do not disclose vulnerabilities, reproduction steps, or proof-of-concept exploits publicly in issues, discussions, or pull requests prior to an official coordinated release.

Please include the following details in your advisory:

- Affected component and version
- Clear step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
- Impact assessment and error logs (if any)
- Suggested fix or mitigation (optional)

In-scope security topics include arbitrary file access, path traversal, command injection, sensitive data leakage, remote code execution, and authorization bypass.

## Coordinated Disclosure and Response Timeline

- **Initial Acknowledgment**: Within 7 business days
- **Severity & Impact Assessment**: Within 14 business days
- **Remediation & Patch Release**: Validated vulnerabilities are typically patched within 60 days
- **Status Updates**: Progress and mitigation workarounds will be communicated through the private advisory.
